title: C: memory, systems and reliable native programs
summary: A complete C17 route from first compilation through pointers, resource ownership, data structures, parsing, concurrency and maintainable systems projects. Safe counterexamples and checked programs make the language rules concrete.

lessons.title: Source, compilation, linking and checked execution
lessons.outcome: Compile, link and run a one-file C17 program whose checks fail loudly instead of printing an unchecked result.
lessons.lab: Start at 1, increment, then multiply by 3.
lessons.verification: The result is 6.

lessons.title: Integer ranges, signedness and floating approximation
lessons.outcome: Predict integer division, unsigned wraparound and floating rounding, and widen before a multiplication can overflow.
lessons.lab: Check sizeof(char) and minimum CHAR_BIT.
lessons.verification: A char occupies one char unit and has at least eight bits.

lessons.title: Expressions, conversions and sequencing
lessons.outcome: Predict grouping, short-circuit evaluation, integer promotion and signed-unsigned conversions before running an expression.
lessons.lab: Increment x and then calculate twice its updated value.
lessons.verification: x is 2 and the result is 4.

lessons.title: Branches, loops and invariants
lessons.outcome: Write branches and loops with explicit invariants that handle zero iterations, exact thresholds and safe reverse traversal.
lessons.lab: Search 3, 8, 8 and stop on the first 8.
lessons.verification: The index is 1.

lessons.title: Functions, prototypes and output parameters
lessons.outcome: Declare prototypes and use output parameters that are written only on success and validated before use.
lessons.lab: Request area with width zero.
lessons.verification: The call fails and output remains -1.

lessons.title: Arrays, bounds and element counts
lessons.outcome: Pass arrays with an explicit element count and keep every access inside the logical length.
lessons.lab: Initialize only the first element of a three-element array.
lessons.verification: The remaining two elements are zero.

lessons.title: Strings, null terminators and output capacities
lessons.outcome: Manage strings with explicit capacity, detect truncation from snprintf's return value and compare content with strcmp.
lessons.lab: Format hello into a four-character buffer.
lessons.verification: The required length is 5 and stored text is hel.

lessons.title: Pointers, addresses and explicit mutation
lessons.outcome: Use pointers to read or update a caller-owned object and reject a null target before dereferencing it.
lessons.lab: Pass NULL to an optional update helper.
lessons.verification: The helper returns false without an access.

lessons.title: Pointer arithmetic and bounded array views
lessons.outcome: Traverse and slice arrays with pointer arithmetic while keeping one-past-the-end pointers undereferenced.
lessons.lab: Sum through a begin/end pointer loop.
lessons.verification: The result is 12.

lessons.title: Structs, enums and tagged domain values
lessons.outcome: Model domain values with structs, enums and tagged unions, and reject an invalid tag instead of guessing.
lessons.lab: Create a tagged number with an integer payload.
lessons.verification: The checked payload is 7.

lessons.title: Scope, storage duration and object lifetime
lessons.outcome: Distinguish scope from storage duration and return only addresses whose objects outlive the call.
lessons.lab: Get a pointer to a static read-only value.
lessons.verification: The target remains valid and equals 7.

lessons.title: Const-correct views and mutation boundaries
lessons.outcome: Use const-qualified views to state which functions may mutate data, and explain what const does not guarantee.
lessons.lab: Create an int pointer that cannot be reassigned, then update its target.
lessons.verification: The target becomes 8.

lessons.title: Preprocessing, macros and compile-time contracts
lessons.outcome: Write safe parenthesized macros, prefer typed functions for side effects and enforce assumptions with _Static_assert.
lessons.lab: Check the language-required char size at translation time.
lessons.verification: Compilation accepts the true static assertion.

lessons.title: Parsing numbers with complete error evidence
lessons.outcome: Parse integers with strtol and reject empty input, trailing characters and out-of-range values using errno and the end pointer.
lessons.lab: Parse an empty string.
lessons.verification: No numeric value is accepted.

lessons.title: Dynamic allocation and single-owner release
lessons.outcome: Allocate with a checked size calculation, initialize the memory and release it exactly once on every path.
lessons.lab: Request zero elements through the helper.
lessons.verification: The helper returns NULL without an allocation.

lessons.title: Reallocation and a checked dynamic vector
lessons.outcome: Implement a growable vector whose reallocation preserves contents and leaves the vector unchanged when growth fails.
lessons.lab: Push twenty sequential values.
lessons.verification: Every stored value matches its index.

lessons.title: Ownership APIs, borrowing and independent clones
lessons.outcome: Design owning and borrowing APIs, clone independent storage and make cleanup safe to call twice.
lessons.lab: Read through a const pointer borrowed from an owner.
lessons.verification: The borrowed content is ready.

lessons.title: File streams, short operations and reliable closure
lessons.outcome: Read and write files with stdio while handling short reads, end-of-file and close errors explicitly.
lessons.lab: Inspect an empty stream before and after a read.
lessons.verification: EOF is false before the read and true afterward.

lessons.title: Binary formats, byte order and representation boundaries
lessons.outcome: Encode and decode fixed-width big-endian integers with explicit length checks and promotion-safe shifts.
lessons.lab: Attempt to decode only three available bytes.
lessons.verification: The decoder fails and preserves output.

lessons.title: Function pointers, callbacks and comparator contracts
lessons.outcome: Pass function pointers as callbacks and write a qsort comparator that is correct for extreme values and ties.
lessons.lab: Compare INT_MIN and INT_MAX.
lessons.verification: The result correctly reports the first is smaller.

lessons.title: Linked lists and mutation-safe traversal
lessons.outcome: Build, count and reverse a singly linked list in place without losing or leaking nodes.
lessons.lab: Measure and destroy a null head.
lessons.verification: Length is zero and head stays NULL.

lessons.title: Stacks, queues and ring-buffer invariants
lessons.outcome: Implement a ring buffer that rejects reads when empty and writes when full while reusing storage in FIFO order.
lessons.lab: Fill four slots and attempt a fifth insertion.
lessons.verification: The fifth fails and occupancy stays four.

lessons.title: Hash tables, collisions and explicit occupancy
lessons.outcome: Implement an open-addressing hash table that resolves collisions and distinguishes an absent key from a stored zero.
lessons.lab: Write key 2 twice with different values.
lessons.verification: The latest value is 8.

lessons.title: Sorting, binary search and complexity evidence
lessons.outcome: Implement a lower-bound binary search that handles empty input, duplicates and the no-match boundary.
lessons.lab: Search 2, 4, 6 for target 9.
lessons.verification: The result is length 3.

lessons.title: Recursion, trees and depth budgets
lessons.outcome: Traverse a binary tree recursively with an explicit depth budget and correct empty-tree behavior.
lessons.lab: Measure the root and two children.
lessons.verification: The depth is 2.

lessons.title: Bounded string builders and failure-atomic appends
lessons.outcome: Build a bounded string builder whose appends either succeed completely or leave the buffer unchanged.
lessons.lab: Append fifteen characters to capacity sixteen.
lessons.verification: The complete payload fits and remains terminated.

lessons.title: Testing, injected allocation failure and useful oracles
lessons.outcome: Inject allocation failures into tests and assert that outputs and existing state survive every failure path.
lessons.lab: Fail allocation while output points to a separate valid buffer.
lessons.verification: The output pointer remains unchanged.

lessons.title: Headers, translation units and reproducible builds
lessons.outcome: Split a program into a header and translation units with one definition per symbol and reproducible behavior.
lessons.lab: Call the same helper with two separate arrays.
lessons.verification: The results are 3 and 7.

lessons.title: Undefined behavior, aliasing and object representation
lessons.outcome: Inspect object bytes with unsigned char and memcpy, and name the aliasing rule that a pointer cast would break.
lessons.lab: Shift abc right by one within a buffer using memmove.
lessons.verification: The buffer prefix becomes aabc.

lessons.title: Sanitizers, debugger evidence and safe regressions
lessons.outcome: Turn a sanitizer finding into a bounds-checked regression test that runs safely without the original undefined behavior.
lessons.lab: Request index zero from an empty logical view.
lessons.verification: No access occurs.

lessons.title: Checked arithmetic and allocation-size contracts
lessons.outcome: Check addition and multiplication for overflow before computing a value or an allocation size.
lessons.lab: Add negative one to INT_MIN.
lessons.verification: The operation fails without evaluating the overflow.

lessons.title: Generic byte APIs, alignment and element-size discipline
lessons.outcome: Write a generic byte-swap API that is parameterized by element size and respects alignment and zero-length calls.
lessons.lab: Invoke the helper with size zero and valid object pointers.
lessons.verification: Both objects remain unchanged.

lessons.title: Flexible array members and single-allocation records
lessons.outcome: Allocate a record with a flexible array member in one checked allocation and clone it without sharing storage.
lessons.lab: Request SIZE_MAX payload bytes.
lessons.verification: The operation returns NULL before allocation.

lessons.title: POSIX descriptors, pipes and explicit endpoint closure
lessons.outcome: Move bytes through a POSIX pipe, observe end-of-file after every write end is closed, and account for duplicated descriptors.
lessons.lab: Write four bytes and request two bytes at a time.
lessons.verification: The pieces are ab and cd.

lessons.title: Signals, interruption and minimal handlers
lessons.outcome: Install a minimal signal handler that only records a flag, and explain why -std=c17 builds must reinstall it after each delivery.
lessons.lab: Raise SIGINT with the lesson handler installed and let a normal-flow function turn the recorded flag into a shutdown decision.
lessons.verification: The decision is continue before the signal and stop after the handler records it.

lessons.title: POSIX threads and joined object lifetimes
lessons.outcome: Create POSIX threads with separate argument storage and join every thread before using its result.
lessons.lab: Have the worker return its caller-owned argument pointer.
lessons.verification: Join returns that same live object address.

lessons.title: Mutexes, condition variables and predicate loops
lessons.outcome: Protect shared state with a mutex and wait on a condition variable inside a predicate loop.
lessons.lab: Run two workers whose increment loops are empty.
lessons.verification: The result remains zero.

lessons.title: C11 atomics and release-acquire publication
lessons.outcome: Use C11 atomics for counters and compare-and-exchange, and publish initialized data with release-acquire ordering.
lessons.lab: Attempt replacement with stale expected value 2 when current is 3.
lessons.verification: It fails and expected becomes 3.

lessons.title: Data layout, locality and honest performance experiments
lessons.outcome: Compare row and column data layouts with an honest, repeatable experiment that keeps results identical.
lessons.lab: Inspect x and y offsets in Point.
lessons.verification: Offsets are within the struct and preserve declaration order.

lessons.title: C ABI boundaries and foreign-function ownership
lessons.outcome: Design a C ABI function with caller-owned buffers, a size query and explicit insufficient-capacity errors.
lessons.lab: Call with no output buffer and capacity zero.
lessons.verification: The required payload length is still reported.

lessons.title: State-machine parsing and bounded input grammars
lessons.outcome: Parse a bounded input grammar with an explicit state machine that rejects empty fields, trailing separators and overflow.
lessons.lab: Parse 1,2,.
lessons.verification: The parse fails.

lessons.title: Capstone: a validated data pipeline with explicit ownership
lessons.outcome: Build a validated record pipeline that commits a summary only when every record parses, so a malformed record never publishes a partial total.
lessons.lab: Summarize zero records.
lessons.verification: Rows and total are both zero.
